title: docs/specs/<N>/mutations.json — mutations a work role declares for the engine to run (VB9)
description: Declared by a developer step when an acceptance criterion says a test must FAIL once some code is removed or changed. Data only, never a command: the engine applies each text replacement to a fresh tree of HEAD, runs the repository's named `test` command under srt and records what it saw (schemas/mutation-record). Nothing here is a claim about the result.

path.description: A tracked production file of HEAD (never a test, a golden, a control file or docs/specs/).

find.description: Literal text that occurs exactly once in the file.
